description: Closes part of #410 (continuation of 054/055) — golden coverage for buildium_list_announcements (posted announcements, #402), one of the 11 read tools from #400-#404 that shipped with unit tests but no agent_flow case. Mirrors 055: the question one-shots buildium_list_announcements; the mirror aggregate tools are mocked empty so the agent takes the documented live-tool fallback. Quality/K-of-N assertions; identifier guard critical; quarantined (single_run_gate:false). DOGFOOD 2026-07-08: even with all nine mirror tools mocked empty and a strongly domain-anchored ask, gemini-2.5-flash returns an EMPTY completion (finish_reason=stop, no tool call, no text) under the Buildium agent's 57-tool schema for this target — 0/20 on the live 20x grid. A trimmed 8-tool agent one-shots the same tool, confirming tool-count (not a case defect) is the cause. The scaffolding here (phrasing + full mirror-empty mocks + the 7 harness mirror mock targets added this PR) is correct, so this stays quarantined (single_run_gate:false) and the nightly eval-flake tracker keeps watching it.
